subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT true about indifference curves between two goods?

options.text: Higher IC means higher satisfaction levels.
They are convex to the origin.

solution:
The correct answer is that __**They may intersect each other.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The statement "They may intersect each other" is not true **about indifference curves between two goods.
 
• **Indifference curves cannot intersect each other **because it would break down the indifference curve analysis
 
• Indifference curves** graphically represent the different levels **of consumer satisfaction at each commodity bundle.
 
• The **slope of Indifference curves is downward sloping.**
 
• **Higher indifference curves (IC) mean higher satisfaction levels.**
